_comment: REPLAY-HUNT CLUSTER C5 -- 'the finish fires and runs out' (61 of its 295 failures), and the
sweep's single largest residual family before this fix (18 of the 24 states the executor pass
repaired are owned by this lever).
Reconstructed from the user's own reference `claude_s5_gi4`, decision 44 (turn 4); it is the
COMBO OFF sweep's state R-0d27093ca5.  Eldrazi Displacer's printed {2}{C} with Peregrine Drake
untapping all the lands: net +4 a pass, net_c +2, and the kill is Living Wish -> Essence
Depleter -> twenty drains at {1}{C}.
WHAT USED TO HAPPEN.  The drain runs at the very END of an iteration, after pay(c) and after the
ETB untap, and it guarded itself with a POOLED `AvailableManaPool + floating vs CanPay`.  That is
the same flat-pool lie MTG_COMBO_OFF_SINK_TRIAL fixed for the damage sink and
MTG_COMBO_OFF_DRAW_TRIAL fixed for the draw sink: a pool cannot see that one land serves ONE of
its modes (Brushland taps for {C} OR {G}/{W}), and it cannot see that the sequential payment
picks greedily.  So the guard said 'the next blink is still payable', the drain took the
colourless that blink needed, and the loop that funds the kill died -- the fetched Essence
Depleter draining a couple of times and stopping.
MTG_COMBO_OFF_TLESS_TRIAL gives both {T}-less sinks (the drain, and the library exile's
instalment route) the same real trial on a copy of the state: pay the sink's cost through the
loop's own payer, then require keep_payable to pay as well.
A/B on this fixture (one binary):
default                          -> COMBO OFF verified, opponent dead
MTG_COMBO_OFF_TLESS_TRIAL=0      -> offered but NOT verified, the apply does not win
The same lever on the real replay (hunt exemplar RR-9f29089519, `claude_s3_gi2` T4, the hunt's
own C5 repro): default wins on turn 4 with 15 blinks and 20 drains; at 0 the click does not win
and the game runs past turn 7.
